'''''Eye''''' can refer to the following:

==[[Old Tongue]]==
* ''sei'' and ''seia'' - Old Tongue words meaning "eye" and "eyes."
* ''seiera'' - an Old Tongue word meaning "blue eyes."
* ''[[Sei'cair]]'' - a word in the Old Tongue meaning "the eyes of gold."
* ''[[Sei'mosiev]]'' - a word in the Old Tongue meaning "downcast eyes," part of [[:Category:Seanchan culture|Seanchan culture]].
* ''[[Sei'taer]]'' - a word in the Old Tongue meaning "straight eyes."
* ''[[Seia Doon]]'' - an [[Aiel]] [[Aiel warrior society|warrior society]], meaning "Black Eyes" in the Old Tongue.

==Book and chapter titles==
* ''[[The Eye of the World]]'' - the first book in ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series.
* [[The Eye of the World comic|''The Eye of the World'' comic]] - a comic based on the first book of the series.
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 29|Eyes Without Pity]]'' - the twenty-ninth chapter of ''The Eye of the World''.
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 50|Meetings at the Eye]]'' - the fiftieth chapter of ''The Eye of the World''.
* ''[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 56|Goldeneyes]]'' - the fifty-sixth chapter of ''[[The Shadow Rising]]''.
* ''[[Lord of Chaos/Chapter 3|A Woman's Eyes]]'' - the third chapter of ''[[Lord of Chaos]]''.
* ''[[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 10|Unseen Eyes]]'' - the tenth chapter of ''[[A Crown of Swords]]''.

==Other==
* [[Eye of the World]] - a location in the [[Great Blight]].
* [[Eyes-and-ears]] - a network of spies and informants used by the [[White Tower]].
